links.outcome: Patient comprehension, cognitive workload, perceived usefulness, reading time and readability of simplified versus standard CT reports
links.effect: Simplified reports gave lower cognitive workload (adjusted OR 0.18), better comprehension (adjusted OR 13.28) and better perceived usefulness (adjusted OR 5.46). Median reading time fell from 7 to 2 minutes. Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level was 8.89 vs 13.69.
links.quote: LLM simplification of oncologic CT reports improved patient comprehension and reduced reading burden.

screen.reason: Prospective controlled trial testing LLM simplification of CT reports with mandatory radiologist review on real oncology patients' comprehension and safety/error rates.

primary.practice: mandatory radiologist review of simplified reports
